messages:
Anya Patel: Heads-up — customer AcmeHealth opened CS-6821. After we moved them to redwood-v4.0 at 09:12 UTC, their structured-output JSON mode started returning null for top-level arrays and fields appear in a different order. They reported downstream parsers failing. Correlation-ID: 8f3b2c9a

Anya Patel: Minimal repro they gave (non-streaming):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v4","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"generate items as json array"}],"json_mode":true}'
```

Anya Patel: Response body they saved: 
```json
{
  "items": null,
  "meta": {"request_id":"8f3b2c9a","model":"redwood-v4"}
}
```

Sanjay Rao: is this streaming or non-streaming?

Anya Patel: non-streaming. They said it worked fine on v3.9 earlier today. They also pasted parser error: 
```
json_parse_error: expected '[' at position 10 got 'null'
```

Support Bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-1473 (severity: high) — linked to CS-6821.

Maria Lopez: @Anya can you confirm route /model-route/customer/acmehealth vs the default route? any per-customer bypass?

Anya Patel: No bypass, they were switched on the standard redwood-v4 rollout ring-3 at 09:12. No config change on the tenant.

Jun Park: I pulled logs from the runtime for that correlation id. Snippet: 
```
[09:12:07] structured_output_validator: top-level key 'items' expected type array but got NULL
[09:12:07] json_formatter: applied ordering transform for model redwood-v4 -> detected trailing punctuation tokens, attempted auto-fix -> produced null for empty array cases
[09:12:07] serve: returning response code 200 content-type application/json
```

Jun Park: Looks like a new model token emission pattern combined with our auto-json-fix path yields null for some empty arrays. Not all requests, but reproducible with that prompt.

Oncall Ops: Immediate mitigation: switch the customer back to v3.9 via admin override and set a short-term routing rule. Command: `POST /admin/tenants/acmehealth/override {"model":"redwood-v3.9"}` — do that now if we want to stop customer impact.

Anya Patel: Doing override now.

Anya Patel: Override applied at 09:16 UTC. Customer confirms parsing works again on v3.9. :thumbsup:

Sanjay Rao: Good. For next steps: 1) add a focused regression test where model emits trailing punctuation, 2) add a schema-tolerant parsing fallback (return partial valid JSON instead of null), 3) inform model team.

Maria Lopez: Filing regression test in QA: RG-JSON-215. Also adding an automated eval to check top-level arrays are arrays (not null) across prompt corpus.

Jun Park: Tentative root cause: model variant in v4 sometimes emits special tokens that our formatter misinterprets as an instruction to drop empty arrays. Patch idea: update json_formatter to treat trailing punctuation as safe content instead of nulling. Quick patch to rollout to ring-0 for verification.

Oncall Ops: I can cut a hotfix branch for json_formatter. Would want a canary to prod-1 for 30m.

Anya Patel: Customer asked for timeline and asked whether tokens could be lost mid-stream. Told them rollback is immediate and we're investigating. They want an RCA and ETA for fix.

Support Bot: :white_check_mark: CS-6821 updated: mitigation applied (model override), incident INC-2026-1473 created, assignees: Jun Park, Sanjay Rao.

Sanjay Rao: Assigning to model-team too. @Maria please loop in Evgeny (model infra) to verify model output distribution change between v3.9 and v4.0.

Maria Lopez: Will do. Also recommending we add a short-term SDK note: "If you rely on strict schema, pin model to redwood-v3.9 until v4.0 fixes are released" — marketing/legal ok with advisory?

Anya Patel: Customer response: grateful for quick rollback, requested weekly updates until fix.

Jun Park: I'll open PR with the formatter patch and run a ring-0 canary. ETA for PR + canary today EOD if no blockers. After canary success, plan to roll to ring-1 tomorrow.

Sanjay Rao: Also add an integration test that exercises non-streaming + json_mode + empty-array prompts. We should prevent regressions. :eyes: 

Anya Patel: I'll keep the customer updated and close the loop once we have PR + canary results.

Oncall Ops: Logging action items: OVERRIDE_DONE (Anya), PATCH_PR (Jun), REGRESSION_TEST (Maria), MODEL_TEAM_ENGAGE (Sanjay).

Maria Lopez: Thanks team. I'll update the incident with the action list and set a 48h follow-up.

Anya Patel: Thanks all.
